brand.name: Tentwood Trips
brand.tagline: Curated Editorial Luxury Journeys & Bespoke Private Escapes
brand.theme: Light mode editorial warm minimalism with Turquoise Blue Header

typography.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.15]
typography.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-slate-900
typography.label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-teal-700

header.type: Sticky Turquoise Header with Mega Menu
header.desktop_menu: Destinations Mega Menu with rich photo previews, Regions (International, Domestic, Visa-Free), Style Escapes, Contact Link
header.mobile_drawer: Slide-over sheet navigation with search, destination links, contact info and direct WhatsApp action button

hero.elements: High-res destination photography background, search filter overlay with interactive autocomplete, badge highlight, quick journey tags

destination_cards.style: Zero over-rounded borders (rounded-lg or rounded-xl max), subtle hover image zoom, rich badges (Visa-Free, Best Season, Curated), price range, duration

itinerary_timeline.style: Day-by-day collapsible sections with detailed meals, stay names, activity tags, and luxury inclusions

whatsapp_integration.default_text: Hi Tentwood Trips! I would like to plan a bespoke luxury journey.

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for standard text over warm linen and 3:1 for large display headers

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: No generic SaaS or AI templates. Use sophisticated editorial travel design inspired by Aman, Belmond, and Roar Africa.
Turquoise Header MUST be dark turquoise (#0D7A84) with crisp white text and bright turquoise hover accents.
Every interactive button, link, search input, card, modal toggle, and form element MUST have a clear data-testid attribute.
All forms MUST show a ready-to-send success state with prefilled WhatsApp action.
All 9 routes must be fully functional and rendered with rich, real, editorial content (no dummy lorem ipsum).
